facts.fact: 三年级生 Balenne 说，Ysabel 曾在冬季学期好心给她们上过一堂 group arrays 辅导课
facts.anchor: she was kind enough to give us a tutorial, in winter term

facts.fact: Jehan 与 Fenehaf 的 Mostau 主医院绑定，只欠三年服务期，而非通常的五年
facts.anchor: And at least he only owed three years instead of the usual five.

facts.fact: 上一任 Mostau 奖学金获得者在二年级末突然 burnout 死去，位置因此空出，Jehan 才抓住这个机会
facts.anchor: died, burning out unexpectedly and dramatically near the end of second year

facts.fact: Moyna 说信件是上周留在邮局并付款要求延迟投递的，据此判断 Ysabel 知道自己届时不会在场
facts.anchor: She left them at a posthouse last week with payment for delayed delivery.

facts.fact: Clement 反驳「从火焰那边寄来的信」之说：这些不是遗书，而是 Ysabel 的计谋，因为 geas 让她无法在考试当天与他们讨论病例
facts.anchor: They aren’t suicide notes. They’re a scheme.

facts.fact: Estiene 暗示 Clement 可能因与 Ysabel 过从甚密或嫉妒她受关注而杀人；Jehan 回呛没人真的在指控他，Estiene 随后向 Clement 道歉
facts.anchor: Nobody was actually accusing you, you self-centred shit

facts.fact: Estiene 说大考的病例主题是提前商定的，以便从医院和诊所找病人；Dean Brodier、院考委，可能还有 Secretary Lefer 都会知道
facts.anchor: The case topics for the Grand Exam are agreed in advance

facts.fact: Estiene 自告奋勇去问 Secretary Lefer，说正好用一用父亲的地位；Alys 坚持同去
facts.anchor: We might as well use my father’s status for something.
